package planted

// planted.go.txt — the POSITIVE CONTROL for TestNoIDLookupOnFirstPage. It holds one planted
// instance of the defect class: an id lookup over ListComments, the read that returns a
// GitHub pull-request thread's first 100 comments as if they were all of it. The guard must
// flag findSignOff; a guard whose matcher stopped matching would report this file clean.
// (The .txt suffix keeps it out of every Go build and out of the shipped-tree scan.)

func findSignOff(fg forge, n int, cid int64) (comment, bool) {
	comments, err := fg.ListComments(repo, n)
	if err != nil {
		return comment{}, false
	}
	for _, c := range comments {
		if c.DatabaseID == cid {
			return c, true
		}
	}
	return comment{}, false
}
